# Animated Fire source

The legacy `apps/web/public/assets/fire/fire1_64.png` and `fire5_64.png` sprite atlases are by Ben Hickling, published as [Animated Fire on OpenGameArt](https://opengameart.org/content/animated-fire) under [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). They were used by an earlier campfire implementation; the current renderer uses faceted geometry instead.

On 29 October 2026, the repository files were compared with the files linked from the source page. Both matched byte-for-byte by SHA-256:

- `fire1_64.png`: `c3dba736f2866e5abd7008f5aae4f548c0a8ebaf61894f75071fe337d2c5b1bc`
- `fire5_64.png` (upstream filename `fire5_64_0.png`): `1552ac6f792fb912ccbacfe1abedbe6c39d9128bedadc6c6099940334dbfd9eb`
